body.prompt: Daylight falling from a high window into a bare stone Senate chamber, grey-haired senators in cream togas lean together and whisper on both sides of the frame while a dark-haired bearded man in a plain linen tunic sits alone and silent on a stone bench in the distance.

Daylight in a hazy stone Senate chamber, two elderly senators in cream togas with dark red trim sit in the foreground turned toward each other, and between them a bearded man in a linen tunic sits still on a stone bench with both hands on a scroll.

Daylight in an empty stone chamber, a dark-haired bearded man in a plain linen tunic sits alone on a stone bench facing the camera, hands resting on an unrolled scroll, soft haze around him as the camera slowly pushes in.
Grey daylight in a rain-soaked pine forest, a long column of Roman legionaries in iron helmets and dark wet cloaks marches toward the camera along a muddy track, mist between the tall trunks.
Grey daylight in a misty pine forest, medium shot of ranks of Roman soldiers in bronze and iron helmets and soaked dark cloaks walking straight at the camera in the rain, red shields at their sides.

Grey daylight in the rain, close-up of a weathered Roman legionary in an iron helmet with cheek guards and a soaked wool cloak pinned with a bronze brooch, marching forward with a hard stare, other helmets blurred behind him.

Daylight streaming through a narrow window into a stone Senate hall, an elderly grey-haired senator in a toga stands up and jabs his hand toward a seated bearded man in a cream toga, who looks back at him without moving while other senators watch from the benches.

Daylight backlight from a tall narrow window, medium two-shot in profile of an angry elderly senator leaning toward a calm bearded man in a cream toga, face to face in a dusty stone hall with seated senators blurred behind.

Daylight glowing through a narrow window behind them, close-up profiles of a scowling grey-haired old senator and a composed bearded man staring at each other a breath apart, rim light on their hair, senators out of focus in the haze.

Pale daylight over a misty river, a line of soldiers in dark helmets and fur cloaks wades through shallow grey water carrying bedrolls on their shoulders and round shields, tall dry reeds and faint hills behind them.

Pale misty daylight, medium shot of helmeted soldiers in fur and green wool cloaks wading knee-deep through a cold river toward the camera, heavy rolled blankets on their shoulders and round wooden shields with iron bosses.

Pale daylight in river mist, close shot of a tired soldier in a dark iron helmet and green wool cloak carrying a heavy rolled blanket on his shoulder and a round shield, trudging forward with other soldiers blurred behind him.
